message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on an artificial hydrangea wreath. Artificial flowers, foliage and fruit and parts thereof fall under heading 6702. Subheading 6702.90 covers other materials, and 6702.10 covers plastics. Polyester fabric is a textile material, so the wreath goes under 6702.90.

The 6702.90 subheading is split into 6702.90.35 (of man-made fibers, 6702.90.3500?) and 6702.90.65 (other). I recall that 6702.90.35 covers articles of man-made fibers, with a duty of 17% and a 6702.90.65 rate of 8%, but I'm not certain. A related ruling classified wreaths with polyester flowers under 6702.90.6500 (Other). The HTS lists 6702.90.10 for feathers, 6702.90.35 for "Of man-made fibers", and 6702.90.65 for "Other". I believe the wreath is of man-made fiber flowers with a natural vine base, so the question is which material predominates for the whole article. Because the flowers and leaves are polyester and the base is mostly obscured, 6702.90.35 is the likely classification.

The 6702.90.35 code applies to "Of man-made fibers" with a general rate of 17%, so I choose that.
